script_text: Saturn's tense square with Uranus forces Aquarius into a career crossroads demanding immediate clarity and bold action. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury's challenging square with Pluto in your 10th House creates workplace power struggles and communication breakdowns, but Tuesday offers relief as Venus trines Neptune, softening conflicts. Wednesday brings a pivotal turning point when Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships, transforming both romantic and professional relationships this month. Thursday through Sunday, the Moon transits your 2nd House of finances, opening unexpected income opportunities and resource management breakthroughs. The weekend culminates in a Mars-Jupiter opposition demanding decisive action. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, activating partnership opportunities and romantic connections. Monday is your worst day due to Mercury square Pluto disrupting career communication and professional credibility. Trust your intuition with financial decisions Thursday, as intuitive insights will guide you toward profitable choices. Follow for daily updates.
